COD.rationale: Identified content (red set) and an explicit origin/organization field are present for the same referent/time, showing content, organization/access and their separation.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content sets (colour-labeled coordinate lists) for named referents and current time.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from an explicit origin/representation-status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/represented_time fields describe how content is presented/derived for named referents.
